Id love to be able to listen to my friends Spotify recommendation feeds, similar to Daylistin other words, the music Spotify recommends specifically to them. This would be really useful when I discover that someone has great taste in music and want to explore it more deeply. Instead of just looking through their playlists or liked songs, Id be able to hear the personalized recommendations Spotify generates for them

[All Platforms] Add Like/Dislike buttons for DJ and Shuffle playback. Currently, when listening to music through Spotify DJ, Smart Shuffle, or other algorithm-based playback, there is no simple way to tell Spotify whether I like or dislike a song without adding it to one of my playlists or using other workarounds. It would be great to add dedicated Like and Dislike buttons directly to these playback modes. This feedback could be used by Spotifys recommendation algorithm to better understand each users music taste and provide more personalized song recommendations in the future, without requiring users to save every song to a playlist

Personalized New Releases Based on Your Listening History. Spotify could create a personalized section that shows new releases from artists, genres, and styles that each user actually listens to. Instead of mainly showing popular new releases, Spotify could prioritize songs that are more likely to match the user's personal taste, based on their recent listening history, favorite artists, and most-played songs. This would make discovering new music easier and more personalized, while reducing the amount of irrelevant recommendations. It could also include a More like this option, allowing users to discover other new releases similar to songs they already enjoy

Spotify Discover Music, Podcasts, and Personalized Playlists. Spotify is one of the world's most popular music streaming platforms, offering millions of songs, podcasts, and audiobooks in one place. It helps users discover new artists, create personalized playlists, and enjoy recommendations based on their listening habits. Whether you're at home, working, or traveling, Spotify provides a seamless listening experience across mobile devices, desktops, and smart speakers. With both free and premium plans available, users can enjoy high-quality audio, offline downloads, and an extensive library of music from different genres, making it a great choice for music lovers around the world
